description: This file defines the UploadedFile class in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation, which models an uploaded file in HTTP requests. It provides methods for handling uploaded files, including moving the file, retrieving its stream, and accessing metadata such as filename and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Implements the PSR-7 UploadedFileInterface to represent an uploaded file, providing mechanisms to access file metadata, move files, and retrieve streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an UploadedFile instance with a stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream of the uploaded file, either the existing stream or a lazy open stream if only a filename is available.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling both move operations and copying streams.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status code.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.
